```yaml
name: Build macOS DMG

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-macos-dmg:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install .; fi

      - name: Install PyInstaller
        run: |
          pip install pyinstaller

      - name: Build Universal Binary
        run: |
          # Build for x86_64
          pyinstaller --name SshPilot-x86_64 --windowed --clean sshpilot.spec || pyinstaller --name SshPilot-x86_64 --windowed --clean main.py
          
          # Build for arm64
          pyinstaller --name SshPilot-arm64 --windowed --clean sshpilot.spec || pyinstaller --name SshPilot-arm64 --windowed --clean main.py

          # Create universal binary using lipo
          mkdir -p SshPilot.app/Contents/MacOS
          
          # Copy resources from one build (assuming they are identical)
          cp -r SshPilot-x86_64.app/Contents/Resources SshPilot.app/Contents/
          cp SshPilot-x86_64.app/Contents/Info.plist SshPilot.app/Contents/
          
          # Create universal binary executable
          lipo -create -output SshPilot.app/Contents/MacOS/SshPilot \
            SshPilot-x86_64.app/Contents/MacOS/SshPilot-x86_64 \
            SshPilot-arm64.app/Contents/MacOS/SshPilot-arm64

          # Verify universal binary
          lipo -info SshPilot.app/Contents/MacOS/SshPilot

      - name: Create DMG
        run: |
          # Install create-dmg if not available
          brew install create-dmg || true
          
          # Create DMG
          create-dmg \
            --volname "SshPilot" \
            --volicon "SshPilot.app/Contents/Resources/icon.icns" \
            --window-pos 200 120 \
            --window-size 600 400 \
            --icon-size 100 \
            --icon "SshPilot.app" 175 120 \
            --hide-extension "SshPilot.app" \
            --app-drop-link 425 120 \
            "SshPilot.dmg" \
            "SshPilot.app"

      - name: Upload DMG Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: SshPilot-macos-universal
          path: SshPilot.dmg

      - name: Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        with:
          files: SshPilot.dmg
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
```
